The '''[[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]''' of the [[Fosh/Legends|Fosh]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEGtAS" /> whose name and location were shrouded in mystery.<ref name="GoI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref> Many [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]] believed that it was located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEGtAS" />
